dedupe_keys.name: agromonitoring agro api satellite and weather data for fields

description: A web API that serves satellite imagery, vegetation indices and weather for fields a user draws. The Agromonitoring page says the Agro API gives satellite imagery of a field every 2 to 4 days with a historical archive, NDVI and other vegetation indices, and current, forecast and historical weather for the field. Access is through an API key and a web dashboard; the pricing page mentions a free plan and paid plans with a wider satellite archive, priced on enquiry, so it is not a free download; licence terms are not stated on the page read. Coverage is global for fields the user defines. Caveats: image dates depend on cloud cover and the page read does not give resolution or index definitions. For simulation it provides field-level time series of crop condition and weather, to calibrate crop stress or yield loss models for drought and heat events. A related catalogue record is the EOSDA agriculture API.
